# robinhood-chain-api

> Hosted market-data API for Robinhood Chain: Stock Tokens with Chainlink + DEX premium/discount, memecoin launchpads, portfolios, cross-venue spreads, real-time firehose. Free + x402-metered.

robinhood-chain-api is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
